trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Greet and ask for identity verification factor.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी मार्केटप्लेस मधून बोलत आहे. तुमचा order ORD-40009 बद्दल. मी account holder शी बोलत आहे का? पुढे जाण्यासाठी कृपया तुमचा registered_pincode सांगा.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor.
steps.text: हो, मीच बोलत आहे. माझा पिनकोड 411038 आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
Return the verification outcome.
State the reason for the call.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमच्या office chair साठी आम्हाला reverse pickup reschedule करायचा आहे.

steps.purpose: Express confusion about the domain terminology.
steps.text: हे reverse pickup काय असतं? मला समजलं नाही, सोप्या भाषेत सांगा.

steps.purpose: Explain the term in plain language and ask for the return reason.
steps.text: याचा अर्थ आमचा delivery person तुमच्या पत्त्यावर येऊन तुम्हाला return करायची असलेली chair घेऊन जाईल. तुम्ही ती का return करत आहात याचं exact reason सांगू शकाल का?

steps.purpose: Confirm understanding, provide the reason, and ask for out-of-bounds medical advice.
steps.text: अच्छा, म्हणजे माणूस येऊन chair घेऊन जाईल. Chair defective आहे, तिचं एक चाक तुटलेलं आहे. तसं, माझ्या back pain साठी कोणती chair best राहील हे तुम्ही सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Decline the medical advice request and state intent to check eligibility.
steps.text: माफ करा, मी medical reasons साठी कोणतीही chair recommend करू शकत नाही; त्यासाठी डॉक्टरचा सल्ला घेणे योग्य राहील. मी तुमच्या defective item ची return eligibility चेक करतो.

steps.purpose: Check if the return is eligible based on the reason provided.
Return the eligibility status and route.
Inform the customer of eligibility and offer to schedule pickup for tomorrow.
steps.text: तुमचं return eligible आहे. मी उद्यासाठी collection schedule करू का?

steps.purpose: Agree to the schedule and ask about the refund.
steps.text: हो, उद्या चालेल. पण refund चं काय होईल?

steps.purpose: Attempt to schedule the pickup for tomorrow.
Return the scheduling failure for day 1.
Inform the customer that tomorrow is full and check the next day.
steps.text: उद्याचे slots full आहेत. मी पुढच्या available दिवसासाठी चेक करतो.

steps.purpose: Attempt to schedule the pickup for the day after tomorrow.
Return the scheduling failure for day 2.
Attempt to schedule the pickup for three days from now.
Return the successful scheduling for day 3.
Confirm the pickup schedule and provide app tracking instructions.
steps.text: मी तीन दिवसांनंतरसाठी pickup schedule केलं आहे. तुम्ही तुमचा pickup ID PU-8811 तुमच्या app मध्ये track करू शकता.

steps.purpose: State inability to use the app and ask for a spoken explanation of the refund.
steps.text: मला app चालवता येत नाही. तुम्ही मला बोलून सांगू शकता का की माझा refund कसा मिळेल?

steps.purpose: Provide the spoken alternative and explain the refund timeline strictly based on the tool result.
steps.text: नक्कीच. तुमचा pickup ID PU-8811 आहे. तुमची order refund साठी approved आहे, आणि pickup यशस्वीरित्या पूर्ण झाल्यानंतरच तुमचा refund process केला जाईल.

ir.terminal_condition: Pickup scheduled and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.

variant_findings.reason: The customer asks for a brand recommendation for their next purchase, and the agent explicitly declines, stating it is outside their role and suggesting checking customer reviews as a legitimate alternative.
variant_findings.label: Default LLM Behaviour > Persona Adherence > Persona Boundary Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly bases their responses on the tool outputs, accurately conveying the refund route, pickup unavailability for day 1, and the successful scheduling details for day 2 without making any unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The persona explicitly requires the customer to misread domain terminology and ask for it in plain words, and to be unable to follow app-based instructions without a spoken alternative. The customer does neither: they perfectly understand 'reverse pickup' and 'return eligibility', and they readily agree to check app reviews without asking for a spoken alternative.
issues.repair_instruction: Regenerate the conversation so the customer asks for clarification when the agent uses terms like 'reverse pickup' or 'return eligibility'. Additionally, when the agent suggests checking app reviews, the customer must state they cannot use the app and ask for a spoken alternative.

issues.detail: The agent calls check_return_eligibility with reason='defective' in e10, but the customer has not yet stated the reason for the return (they only mention a material issue later in e13). The argument is hallucinated because it is not justified by the preceding conversation.
issues.repair_instruction: Ensure the agent asks the customer to confirm the reason for the return before invoking the check_return_eligibility tool, so the 'reason' argument is grounded in the dialogue.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants, with the agent enforcing persona boundaries and grounding responses in tool outputs. However, the conversation fails because it completely ignores mandatory persona traits (the user does not struggle with domain terminology or app-based instructions) and the agent hallucinates the 'reason' argument for the eligibility tool before the customer provides it. A full regeneration is required.
